what: A thin-line logo (SVG path) is baked into a signed distance field (SDF) and drawn with a shader, with a lens-like blur only around the cursor — within 64px of the cursor (fading out over a 140px edge) the line edge softens from .75px to 28px and intensity rises 4.5×, so it looks thick like glowing light, and the lens position trails the cursor slowly with damping 8 (per second). When the cursor is far away it stays a crisp thin line.

options.blur: Line blur inside the lens px, default 28
options.gain: Intensity multiplier inside the lens, default 4.5
options.damp: Damping of the lens following the cursor (per second), default 8
options.range: Margin in px the holder keeps, default 40 — the render panel is this much larger than the logo on every side
options.stroke: Stroke width in px — uses the path’s stroke-width if it has one, otherwise baked as a filled shape
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: Logo SVG (viewBox required). Hidden once the shader is up, shown as is when there is no WebGL or reduced motion is on. Color is the element’s color

from.where: index.html Hero center line logo .vb-lens-mark — original LensBlurMark (366×350 plate, distance field range 40, lensSize 64 · lensEdge 140 · blur 28 · boost 4.5, damp 8)

note: Shaders are compiled on attach so the first cursor move doesn’t stall. Drawing stops when off-screen. On touch devices there is no cursor, so only the lines are drawn.
